# G0 admin-skill golden fixture

These four files are human-reviewed, test-only quality references for the local
Admin skill draft generator. Production code must not import this directory or
branch on its video ID, utterance IDs, timestamps, titles, or card contents.

Regression tests use the fixture to check semantic workflow coverage, typed DROP
behavior, prompt provenance, classification variety, and scale. Exact generated
titles and exact PART/STEP counts are not runtime rules.
